scope: read-only hardware evidence report (wsm-hwcheck 0.2.0, report schema 1.0.0)
three installer frontends over one backend: console (--guided), pseudo-graphical (--tui) and the Calamares jobmodule
privileged agent: the unprivileged side writes a plan, root executes only an allowlisted set of commands
execution journal and recovery report: what ran, what failed, and what to check next
environment preflight: tools, guix, root, mount point, system file, report and ISA level, before the first disk is touched
authenticated free-only Guix channel lock and an authenticated Compatibility lock with Nonguix
reproducible source bundle with checksums and build manifest
KDE Plasma desktop profile, a minimal console live profile and a live-ISO recipe, shipped as unverified source (not as an image built here)
excluded: any write to a physical block device, partition table or bootloader: the installer has never run on a disk
a verified installation: no install has completed anywhere, in QEMU or on hardware
the Compatibility image: systems/live-compat.scm and channels/compatibility.lock.scm exist and pass policy checks, but were never built here
the Nix/NixOS backend: ADR 0004 keeps Guix as the only supported backend
a claim of performance: the baseline harness exists, no physical-machine measurement has been published
